Summary: USER_CONTEXT: Investigate potential memory corruption bug in open62541 JSON decode/encode for Variant arrays. The fuzz target decodes JSON to UA_Variant, encodes back, decodes again, and compares. Focus on `Array_decodeJson_internal` writing array length to `*(size_t*)(dst - 1)` which assumes `arrayLength` field precedes `data` pointer in UA_Variant struct.

COMPLETED:
- Located `UA_Variant_deleteMembers` usage across codebase
- Found `UA_clear`, `UA_delete`, `UA_Array_delete` implementations in `ua_types.c`
- Found `UA_Variant` type definition (UA_TYPES_VARIANT = 23)
- Found `Array_decodeJson_internal` at line 3119 in `ua_types_encoding_json.c` - writes length to `*(size_t*)dst - 1`
- Found `Array_decodeJson` wrapper at line 3164
- Found `DECODE_JSON(Variant)` at line 2622 - calls `Array_decodeJson` for array body
- Found `ENCODE_JSON(Variant)` at line 1159
- Found `UA_Array_delete` at line 1104 - handles `UA_EMPTY_ARRAY_SENTINEL`
- Found `UA_Array_copy` at line 1065
- Found `UA_copy` at line 973
- Found `clearStructure` at line 148 - handles array member cleanup
- Found `NodeId_clear`, `String_clear` implementations
- Found `UA_NodeId` struct (namespaceIndex, identifierType, union identifier)
- Found `UA_String` struct (length, data)
- Found `UA_EMPTY_ARRAY_SENTINEL` defined as `((void*)0x01)` at line 544
- Found fuzz target `fuzz_json_decode_encode.cc` - decodes JSON to Variant, encodes, decodes again, compares
- Found `encodeJsonArray` at line 502

PENDING:
- Understand the exact memory layout issue: `Array_decodeJson_internal` writes length to `*(size_t*)(dst - 1)` which assumes `arrayLength` field is immediately before `data` pointer in UA_Variant struct
- Verify if this assumption holds for all platforms/compilers (struct padding)
- Check if the bug causes corruption when decoding Variant arrays
- Determine if fix is needed in `Array_decodeJson_internal` or in the Variant decode logic

CODE_STATE:
- `/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/open62541/src/ua_types_encoding_json.c`: `Array_decodeJson_internal` (line 3119), `DECODE_JSON(Variant)` (line 2622), `ENCODE_JSON(Variant)` (line 1159), `encodeJsonArray` (line 502)
- `/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/open62541/src/ua_types.c`: `UA_Array_delete` (line 1104), `UA_Array_copy` (line 1065), `UA_copy` (line 973), `clearStructure` (line 148), `NodeId_clear` (line 235), `String_clear` (line 139)
- `/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/open62541/include/open62541/types.h`: `UA_NodeId` struct (line 313), `UA_String` struct (line 152), `UA_EMPTY_ARRAY_SENTINEL` (line 544)
- `/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/open62541/tests/fuzz/fuzz_json_decode_encode.cc`: Fuzz target

TESTS: Fuzz target `fuzz_json_decode_encode.cc` - decodes JSON to Variant, encodes, decodes, compares two encodings

CHANGES: None yet

DEPS: open62541 library, jsmn JSON parser

VERSION_CONTROL_STATUS: Repository at `/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/open62541`
